title: Chuck Loyola
html_source: As in: ‘be rid of St. Ignatius of Loyola’. St. Ignatius was the founder of the Jesuit order.

anchor.prefix:
ed loudly: 

 — Are you up there, Mulligan? 

 — I'm coming, Buck Mulligan answered. 

 He turned towards Stephen and said: 

 — Look at the sea. What does it care about offences?
anchor.suffix:
, Kinch, and come on down. The Sassenach wants his morning rashers. 

 His head halted again for a moment at the top of the staircase, level with the roof: 

 — Don't mope over it
